title: Use the configured CTest environment for WSL captures
body: Failed comparison: the queued baseline capture comparator exited 1 after the direct tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh run produced four editor PNGs with center-only pixel differences against the official CTest witness (all three HUD PNGs matched). The CTest witness injects DISPLAY=:0 and VIXEN_CTEST_GPU_ENVIRONMENT; two consecutive official runs were byte-identical. Make the standalone capture helper obtain that configured Vulkan loader environment, or make the common lane recipe use the official CTest witness.

title: Use non-destructive unique paths for queued witness status files
body: A foreground interval watcher command containing rm -f for its per-run log/status path was blocked by the worktree-guard hook before execution. I switched to unique log and status names without cleanup. The watcher guidance should provide a non-destructive unique-path pattern, or the guard should distinguish a task-local generated log from destructive worktree cleanup.

title: Generate identity-equivalent affine SDF shader specialization
body: To preserve byte-identical identity-scale procedural pixels after adopting the affine transform stream, TraceWorld.glsl uses preserveLegacyProcedural guards to retain the old world-space ray operation order in primary and shadow paths. The declarative transform form does not encode or generate this compatibility specialization. Consolidate by deriving an identity-equivalent affine shader path from the transform contract.

title: Isolate FetchContent build outputs for archived baseline witnesses
body: The fc69 baseline and merged run2 build trees both resolved FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR to the worktree-wide .tmp/fetch cache. Building focused baseline targets then caused the merged CMake tree to rebuild 557 units. Keep fetched source downloads shareable but isolate generated FetchContent build outputs per CMake binary tree, or ensure witness setup selects a per-build cache.

title: Provision Vulkan SDK for archived baseline witnesses
body: A configure of the exact-base source archive with -DVIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_VULKAN=OFF exited 1 because the archive excludes ignored VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk. Recovery used the documented auto-provision path with -DVIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_VULKAN=ON and -DVIXEN_VULKAN_CACHE_DIR=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/insttransform/VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk; it reused the cached SDK and configured successfully. Make the baseline witness setup select the documented provisioning path and cache automatically so this manual retry/extra cache property is not needed.

title: Declare stored-SDF traversal normal space
body: The affine inverse-transpose conversion on primary stored-SDF hits changed the native editor cel pixels, while preserving hitNormal from traversal restored the four captures byte-for-byte. The compatibility rule is hand-coded in TraceWorld.glsl; add normal-space metadata to the facade so generated shader code applies the transform exactly once.

title: Derive effective mining-beam GPU enabled state
body: The beam upload must clamp enabled and beamCount together to zero when disabled or empty so inactive records cannot perturb editor and Cornell captures. The facade exposes the fields independently and does not derive this no-work contract; add a declarative empty-list policy that emits effective count and enabled state together.

title: Resolve capture output roots before launching apps
body: The windowed capture helper launches apps after changing to their binary directory but passes a relative output root through unchanged. A relative root made the app write under a different directory than the script verifies; an absolute root recovered the witness. Canonicalize the root or reject relative paths before launch.
